linkedin:
Only 22% of active remote listings disclose a salary figure. That means 78% of the 4,269 remote USD jobs on our board are silent on pay — most candidates negotiate without any baseline.

A few figures from the data: 2,725 listings (64%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world, 1,205 were posted in the last 7 days, and AI is required in 12% of listings while communication appears in 39%. Top disclosed ranges reach USD 293,000–325,000/yr (OpenAI Data Scientist) and USD 195,000–319,000/yr (Equinix Chief of Staff).

The practical take: don't chase the average. Target the transparent 22% where the range is explicit — filter for "USD salary disclosed" and apply while roles are fresh.
